name: Incline Dumbbell Press
summary: A dumbbell press on an incline bench that emphasizes the upper chest with a flexible arm path.
setup: Set the bench to about 30 degrees; avoid very steep angles that turn it into a shoulder press.
Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and bring them to chest level.
Set shoulder blades back and down, feet planted firmly.
Start with palms facing forward or slightly angled in, wrists stacked over elbows.
execution: Press the dumbbells up and slightly together until the arms are straight.
Lower under control until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep elbows about 45-70 degrees from the torso.
Bring the dumbbells back to your thighs before sitting up.
mistakes: Bench too steep: lower the angle so the chest keeps working.
Arching the lower back and flaring ribs: keep ribs down and glutes on the bench.
Weights too heavy to control: reduce load and keep the lowering slow.
